results.label: scam
results.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of $1.99. Pay within 12 hours or it will be returned: http://usps-redelivery-help.top/pay
results.summary: This is a fake USPS delivery scam — the link is not on the real usps.com and USPS never texts to collect customs fees this way.

results.label: scam
results.text: FedEx: We attempted delivery but nobody was home. Confirm your address and reschedule here: fedex-reschedule-now.info/track?id=88213
results.summary: This is a FedEx impersonation scam — the link uses a fake domain (fedex-reschedule-now.info) that doesn't match the official fedex.com and doesn't even resolve.

results.label: scam
results.text: DHL Express: your parcel is held at our depot. A customs charge of $2.45 is required. Pay at dhl-customs-pay.xyz to release it.
results.summary: This DHL customs-payment text is a scam — it asks you to pay at dhl-customs-pay.xyz, which is not DHL's real website (dhl.com).

results.label: scam
results.text: NJ E-ZPass: You have an unpaid toll balance of $12.50. To avoid a $50 late fee, pay by today: ezpass-nj-tollpay.top/inv
results.summary: This is a fake NJ E-ZPass toll smishing text sending you to ezpass-nj-tollpay.top, not a real E-ZPass site, using a "pay by today" threat to steal payment info.

results.summary: Fake Chase alert trying to steal your login — the link is not chase.com and uses pressure about a locked account.

results.label: scam
results.text: This is the Social Security Administration. Your social security number has been suspended due to suspicious activity. Call 855-555-0150 or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi Sarah, are we still on for dinner Friday? Let me know!

results.summary: Unsolicited friendly intro from a stranger asking to chat — a common wrong-number opener that often leads to later money or investment requests.
